name: Translational Res and App Med

rules.name: Required Courses
rules.notes: Complete 3 quarters of TRAM 221. Total of 6 units.

rules.name: Track Selection
rules.desc: Complete one of the following tracks.

children.name: Track Option 1: Translational Research Individual Project (TRIP)
children.desc: The TRIP track requires a faculty-mentored individual capstone research project. Summer quarter enrollment is required.
children.notes:
Complete 3 units in TRAM 212B, 3 units in TRAM 250, 14 units in TRAM 299M, and 6 units in TRAM 299P.
Students pursuing an MD may substitute MED 370 for TRAM 299M.

children.name: Track Option 2: Translation, Entrepreneurship, and Applied Medicine (TEAM)
children.desc: The TEAM track requires a total of 26 units including a collaborative team-based capstone project, organized by therapeutic or focus area. Summer quarter enrollment is optional.

children.name: TEAM project courses
children.notes: Complete 2 units in CSB 245, 2 units in GSBGEN 551, and 12 units in TRAM 299P. The CSB and GSBGEN classes can be substituted with electives upon program approval.

children.name: 10 Units in TEAM Electives
children.desc: Complete 10 units in pre-approved MTRAM electives for a total of 26 units in the TEAM Project Track.

transferPolicy: Transfer credit is not accepted for the master's program.
reviewNotes: You take the required TRAM courses (three quarters of TRAM 221) and one track: TRIP (TRAM 212B, TRAM 250, 14 units of TRAM 299M or MED 370 for MD students, and 6 units of TRAM 299P) or TEAM (CSB 245, GSBGEN 551, 12 units of TRAM 299P and 10 elective units), for 52 units. TRAM 299P is taken more than once to reach those units. The TEAM electives come from a pre-approved list that is not in the Bulletin, so you move them in by hand.
